notes: *made by fire* is part of ʾiššēy's own rendering, not a supplied lexical verb: it is what that noun's lexeme names, and the unit is discontinuous across *of Jehovah the God of Israel* (rule 25).
The head of that unit stays on *offerings*, the class noun the ASV writes for words of this class, rather than on *fire*; rule 31's tie-break was read the other way as the competing reading.
The clause negation is recast onto the object as *no* (rule 15), and the resuming hûʾ is unrepresented with the copula going to the predicate (rule 20).
